# M7-S3: comptime expansions that spell a Go-intermediary field type (SPEC
# Sec 2.5, T-205). Package wire exports the comptime generic Describe,
# whose const for body converts each field with Convert[f.Type](in)? and
# interpolates $"{f.Name}={Show(v)};". Package main instantiates
# Describe over gopkg.Row, an ordinary-Go struct holding a public
# deep.Level field, and imports neither deep nor anything that spells it.
# Package direct runs the same conversion over the same Row with a local
# const for over comptime.Fields[gopkg.Row] and no imported comptime
# generic at all, so no foreign-record presence gate can mask its need.
# Both copies spell deep.Level through a synthesized import alias and must
# type-check under that alias for the `?` and the interpolation to lower.
# The go command adds every transitive built package in the instantiating
# package's existing action graph that it does not import directly, sorted
# by import path, to its import config for build and for lint alike; the
# same set feeds the action ID. This reaches deep transitively through the
# ordinary-Go gopkg package. Only loGo/s roots gain these synthesized
# imports; plain-Go roots add nothing.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
# The instantiating packages never name deep in source.
logos list -f '{{.Imports}}' ./main
! stdout 'deep'
logos list -f '{{.Imports}}' ./direct
! stdout 'deep'

logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^Name=7;Level=L7;Count=7; <nil>$'
stdout '^bad: expected integer$'
logos run ./direct
stdout '^Name=7;Level=L7;Count=7; <nil>$'
stdout '^bad: expected integer$'

logos lint ./...

# wire's records name fmt, not deep or gotypes: deep reaches main only
# through the ordinary-Go field type gopkg.Row -> deep.Level, never
# through the defining package's imports.
logos build -o $WORK/wire.a ./wire
go tool pack p $WORK/wire.a __.LOGOS
stdout 'comptime Describe'
! stdout 'deep'
! stdout 'gotypes'

# A deep change invalidates the cached build: Level's String feeds the
# asserted output, and the action ID carries the same synthesized import set, so
# both instantiating packages rebuild through the new deep archive.
cp patched.txt ../godep/deep/deep.go
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^Name=7;Level=D7;Count=7; <nil>$'
stdout '^bad: expected integer$'
logos run ./direct
stdout '^Name=7;Level=D7;Count=7; <nil>$'
stdout '^bad: expected integer$'
logos lint ./...

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/foreigntest

go 1.27

require example.com/gotypes v0.0.0

replace example.com/gotypes => ../godep

-- w/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func Convert[V any](s string) (V, error) {
	var v V
	_, err := fmt.Sscan(s, &v)
	return v, err
}

func Show[V any](v V) string {
	return fmt.Sprint(v)
}

func Describe[T any](in string) (string, error) {
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		v := Convert[f.Type](in)?
		out += $"{f.Name}={Show(v)};"
	}
	return out, nil
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gotypes/gopkg"
	"example.com/foreigntest/wire"
)

func main() {
	out, err := wire.Describe[gopkg.Row]("7")
	fmt.Println(out, err)
	_, err = wire.Describe[gopkg.Row]("x")
	fmt.Println("bad:", err)
}

-- w/direct/direct.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gotypes/gopkg"
)

func Convert[V any](s string) (V, error) {
	var v V
	_, err := fmt.Sscan(s, &v)
	return v, err
}

func Show[V any](v V) string {
	return fmt.Sprint(v)
}

func DescribeLocal(in string) (string, error) {
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[gopkg.Row]() {
		v := Convert[f.Type](in)?
		out += $"{f.Name}={Show(v)};"
	}
	return out, nil
}

func main() {
	out, err := DescribeLocal("7")
	fmt.Println(out, err)
	_, err = DescribeLocal("x")
	fmt.Println("bad:", err)
}

-- w/patched.txt --
package deep

import "strconv"

type Level int

func (l Level) String() string {
	return "D" + strconv.Itoa(int(l))
}

-- godep/go.mod --
module example.com/gotypes

go 1.27

-- godep/deep/deep.go --
package deep

import "strconv"

type Level int

func (l Level) String() string {
	return "L" + strconv.Itoa(int(l))
}

-- godep/gopkg/gopkg.go --
package gopkg

import "example.com/gotypes/deep"

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Level deep.Level
	Count int
}
